GitHub sanitizes repository Markdown and does **not** run embedded JavaScript or page CSS. The animated title/header above are remotely rendered image assets; use the live-card link to experience the actual pointer-reactive card and motion system.

## Repository map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `identity-card/index.html` | Standalone card document |
| `identity-card/site.css` | Card styling, layers, responsive rules, visual effects |
| `identity-card/motion-core.js` | Motion coordination and timing |
| `identity-card/card-interactions.js` | Pointer and interaction behavior |
| `id-card.svg` | Minimal SVG identity placeholder |

## Design principles

- **Identity first:** the project is the ID card, not a portfolio rebuild.
- **Motion first:** preserve the card's existing animation and interaction architecture.
- **Source stays inspectable:** HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are separated for direct review.
- **Respect reduced motion:** avoid forcing continuous motion on users who request less animation.
- **Keep the original intact:** use the live-card link for the original website experience.

## 10,000-line engineering reference

This long-form reference is intentionally organized as numbered, searchable entries rather than an unstructured wall of repeated filler. Each entry is a review prompt for the identity card implementation; it does not claim that every item is already implemented or independently tested.
